data.exact_reserve_text: The updates have resulted in ultimate gross reserves of GBP 393.4m, GBP 113.8m net of reinsurance (31 December 2023 - GBP 264.5m gross, GBP 84.5m net of reinsurance) as at 31 December 2024. The casualty business group experienced deterioration to the prior year reserves as a result of construction defect claims in Florida. The syndicate has seen an increase in the frequency of lawsuits relating to issues on its Florida based contractors book arising from construction defects. Due to the continued adverse development seen during the year additional gross reserves of GBP 52.7m and GBP 52.3m net of reinsurance were recorded bringing the overall gross reserves for this class to GBP 132.0m (2023 - GBP 79.4m) and net reserves to GBP 131.3m (2023 - GBP 79.0m).

prior_year_events.impact_description: Significant uncertainty and adverse development relating to western-leased aircraft in Russia; updates resulted in ultimate gross reserves increasing to GBP 393.4m (gross) and GBP 113.8m net of reinsurance as at 31 December 2024, an increase from GBP 264.5m gross at 31 December 2023.
Deterioration in prior year reserves due to increased frequency of lawsuits on Florida contractors book; additional gross reserves of GBP 52.7m were recorded.

named_events.event_name: Dali ship collision (Francis Scott Key Bridge, Baltimore)
named_events.loss_description: Syndicate exposure of GBP 64.1m gross and GBP 7.3m net of reinsurance contributing to gross and net loss ratios across Marine and Energy Liability, Non Gulf of Mexico Wind, Marine Hull and Cargo Fine Art & Specie classes.

Property business group affected with combined gross and net losses of GBP 29.0m and GBP 10.0m respectively across Property Reinsurance, Non Marine Direct & Facultative, Property Direct USA and Cargo Fine Art & Specie classes.
Loss reserve for Hurricane Ian reduced slightly over the year; reserve now stands at GBP 24.2m gross and GBP 24.1m net of reinsurance recoveries.
Overall industry loss estimates range between $30bn to $50bn; syndicate quantum to be determined and expected to impact 2024 year of account.
Ultimate gross reserves of GBP 393.4m and GBP 113.8m net of reinsurance as at 31 December 2024 (31 December 2023 - GBP 264.5m gross, GBP 84.5m net).

data.standardized_narrative: During 2024 there was material adverse prior-year development driven principally by exposures to western-leased aircraft in Russia and by construction-defect litigation on the Florida contractors book. The syndicate increased ultimate gross reserves (notably for the Russia aviation-related exposures) and recorded further gross strengthening on casualty/contractors (Florida) with additional gross reserves. Other 2024 large losses (e.g., the Dali bridge collapse and several hurricanes) also contributed to overall reserve strengthening on affected lines including Marine, Energy and Property.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (PYD) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (claims development table) because a single-line 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross figure was not presented separately. The triangle calculation yields a gross PYD of +GBP 194.623m (strengthening). This result is consistent with narrative items (e.g. an explicit additional gross reserve of GBP 128.9m for the Russia aviation exposures and GBP 52.7m for Florida construction defects). The triangle and movement may be influenced by large case reserve adjustments and RITC/Reinsurance movements; RITC-related distortions were checked and no single-year RITC distortion materially invalidated the triangle for 2015-2022 columns used. All monetary amounts are presented in millions GBP; the triangle source is presented in thousands in the report and was converted to millions for the PYD figure.
